description: This file defines API routes for managing job applications within a job portal backend. It includes endpoints for applying to a job and retrieving application listings, handling user authentication via OAuth2, and managing application data including resume uploads.

methods.name: apply_to_job( job_id: int = Form(...), user_id: int = Form(...), resume: UploadFile = File(None), token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme) )
methods.description: Endpoint for candidates to apply to a job, optionally uploading a resume file.

methods.name: get_applications(job_id: int = None, user_id: int = None, token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme))
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve a list of applications, optionally filtered by job ID or user ID.

ctags.name: apply_to_job
ctags.signature: ( job_id: int = Form(...), user_id: int = Form(...), resume: UploadFile = File(None), token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme) )

ctags.name: get_applications
ctags.pattern: /^def get_applications(job_id: int = None, user_id: int = None, token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme/
ctags.signature: (job_id: int = None, user_id: int = None, token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme))
